status: review-only lower-face reduction; actual duplicated left/right lower-face cuts and independent MK4S ASA slice checks; not a production release

lower_face_cut.selection_rule: Use exactly the V2-approved complete source facets owned by the two lower-face sections whose centroids have signed distance at least -70 mm from the V0.5 shared rear plane.

review_holds: Only duplicated left_lower_face and right_lower_face meshes are cut; the Gate 8 source blend and original production objects are not overwritten.
No upper-head, ear, rear_base, eye, connector, reinforcement redesign, socket, insert, rail, backplate, hardware, seal, drain, or wiring geometry is changed.
Internal Gate 8 reinforcement components are retained except where they physically intersect the approved subtraction volume; reinforcement continuity is a later feedback item.
The cut STLs and G-code are review artifacts for geometry and bed-fit validation only, not production print release files.
The rear cassette connection and reconciliation around the V0.5 aluminum plate, rails, shoes, hardware, tool, wiring, insertion, and removal envelopes remain deferred.
